title: Receipts and Repairs: The Record Is the Work

intelligence.essence: A write is complete at its receipt, not its save (SN-0588); a receipt is honest when it names what was measured, what was only cited, and what remains unknown (SN-0446); a repair is disciplined when it proves impossibility with exact numbers instead of fabricating a fix (SN-0357), re-pins tests to the new invariant instead of weakening the guard (SN-0359), and corrects the record by appending — never by silent overwrite (SN-0448, SN-0398). Every verdict carries two ledgers: defects, and the framing residuals that fence what the verdict may be cited as (SN-0532).
intelligence.human_view: This is the block's bookkeeping soul: how a fast team keeps a record it can still trust tomorrow. The pattern across all twelve notes is that the record is not paperwork after the work — the record IS the work's durable half. Receipts that say exactly what was measured and what wasn't, corrections appended instead of airbrushed, repairs that would rather declare impossibility than fabricate a hash, verdicts that fence themselves with their own limitations. A cold successor inherits not just conclusions but the means to re-derive them — or to see precisely where derivation stops.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine a class where every student keeps a lab notebook. The rules: when you finish an experiment, you get a stamped receipt — no stamp, it didn't happen. If you recount your marbles and get a different number, you write BOTH numbers and why ("I counted the corner one this time") — you never erase. If your friend checks your work, they don't just read your notebook; they look at the actual marbles and say exactly which pages they checked and which they didn't. And if the teacher's plant-watering chart has a blank day, that's a problem to fix that day — a diary with holes can't prove anything.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's the discipline of a good bookkeeper in a family business: every sale gets a receipt, every correction gets a new line with a reason — never an eraser — and the daily takings are written down daily, because a ledger reconstructed from memory next week is fiction. When the bank statement and the cabinet disagree, you note it for the bookkeeper; you don't sneak in and alter her books. And when a bill truly cannot be paid honestly, you say so with the figures shown, instead of cooking them.
intelligence.ai_view: On every receipt and repair: prove impossibility numerically before declaring it, and leave the bytes untouched when honesty forbids the fix (SN-0357); re-pin, never weaken (SN-0359); isolate batch failures per item and record them loudly (SN-0366); classify before closing anything in a cleanup (SN-0397); kill stale claims by live re-measurement in the same venue (SN-0398); treat hash hits as reread orders and name drift by class (SN-0424); write relay receipts that re-measure pins and declare the cited-not-rerun line (SN-0426, SN-0446); append corrections with causes (SN-0448); ship both ledgers with every verdict (SN-0532); feed trend instruments daily (SN-0577); and close every write at its receipt, repairing authority without widening it (SN-0588).
intelligence.what_it_means: Twelve notes make record-keeping a branch of engineering: receipts with declared scope, corrections with causes, verdicts with fences, repairs with proofs — including proofs that no honest repair exists. A cold reader holding only this essence can write a receipt the next seat can trust, repair without corrupting the record that proves the repair, and inherit any claim in this block knowing exactly how far its evidence reaches.
whats_inside: Impossibility is proven with exact numbers and declared — never repaired by fabrication or baseline-bumping (SN-0357).
Repairs re-pin to the new invariant; weakening the guard is scored and rejected (SN-0359).
Batch pipelines isolate failures per item: one malformed input never shelves the batch (SN-0366).
Cleanup retires authority, not records; burdens route by lifecycle classification, never mass-close (SN-0397).
Stale external-state claims are killed by live re-measurement, publicly, in the same venue (SN-0398).
A hash hit earns a runtime reread; drift is named by class; heals are proven by failure shape (SN-0424).
Relay receipts re-measure pins, declare cited-not-rerun, and carry the gaps in the same breath (SN-0426, SN-0446).
Re-measurements append with their cause; records are never silently corrected (SN-0448).
Every verdict ships two ledgers: defects and framing residuals (SN-0532).
Trend instruments are fed daily or the gap is repaired same-day (SN-0577).
A write completes at its receipt; silent receipt paths are defects (SN-0588).
